BEGINNING at a point in the Northeasterly line of Lot 10, Block 76, where intersected by the Southerly line of Lot 12.10, Block 76, said point being North 32 degrees 22 minutes 35 seconds West, 81.33 feet from the intersection of Northeasterly line of Lot 10 with the Southerly line of Lot 12.13, Block 76 as shown on Plan hereinafter mentioned; thence

(1) Along said division line, North 32 degrees 22 minutes 35 seconds West, 20.02 feet to a point in the division line of Lots 12.10 and 12.09 as shown on Plan hereinafter mentioned; thence

(2) Along said division line, North 61 degrees 11 minutes 33 seconds East, 86.41 feet to a point in the Southwesterly line of Lot 12.04, Block 76; thence

(3) Along said Southwesterly line of Lot 12.04 and along the Southwesterly line of Lot 12.05 as shown on Plan hereinafter mentioned, South 28 degrees 36 minutes 51 seconds East, 19.98 feet to a point in the division line of Lots 12.10 and 12.11 as shown on Plan hereinafter mentioned; thence

(4) Along said division line, South 61 degrees 11 minutes 33 seconds West, 85.10 feet to the point and place of beginning.

critical_assertions.note: Resale uses 33" and 35" seconds in bearings (calls 1,2,4) while original deed 7535-1127 used 34" seconds. Both describe the same Lot 12.10. Legal description appears twice in this deed (once in body, once as Schedule C attachment).

common_failure_modes: Bearing seconds differ from original deed (33"/35" vs 34") - both are correct survey descriptions of same lot
Legal description appears twice in the deed (body and Schedule C) - parser may extract duplicates
Call (1) uses N 32d22'35" W (35") vs original deed's N 32d22'34" W (34")
notes: Resale of Lot 12.10 from O'Donnell to Llenado. O'Donnell bought for $409,999 (deed 7535-1127) and sold for $484,000. The resurvey used slightly different bearing seconds (33"/35") compared to the original survey (34") for the same lot. The distance of call (1) also changed from 20.01 to 20.02 ft.
